title: A real bond: the Morse potential
caption: A real bond is not a perfect spring. Squeezing the atoms together is very hard (the steep left wall) and stretching it far enough breaks it (the curve levels off at the dissociation energy). The vibrational levels get closer together towards the top. Values roughly for H₂.
alt: Potential energy against bond length: a steep wall at short distance, a minimum at 0.074 nm and a curve levelling off at about 4.75 eV at long distance.
description: Minimum at the bond length, 0.074 nm.
Levelling off at the dissociation energy, about 4.75 eV.
